scope: Actual supervisor main control flow, actual inert own process sessions terminated. GPU/process inventory and CPU affinity are mocked; no GPU, seismic solver, production worker or foreign process is used.
foreign_PID_signal_guard: Every killpg asserts pgrp equals an actual own Popen child PID with start_new_session=True and differs from parent/foreign groups. Direct kill is also restricted to own child IDs.
limitations: Mock GPU inventory tests policy branches only. Actual remote resource telemetry and sampling gaps remain separately reported; no instantaneous or foreign-job-preemption guarantee.

sanitization.scope: Public path identifiers only; all original numeric values, solver/source SHA values, outcomes and limitations preserved.

portable_public_reproducer.scope: Public script path/CLI handling is relocatable; its SHA may differ from the original private executed reader. The historical numeric solver/source SHA remains unchanged.
